data.text: Kickoff for Rowan Wardrobe, Rowan Wash, and Olivia's separate Sunday private note: keep the three threads separated in memory. Rowan Wardrobe covers Friday fitting and Sunday garment return. Rowan Wash covers Saturday linen pickup and Sunday steamer setup. Olivia's exact Sunday off-site timing is restricted and must never be folded into helper or building summaries.
